spine_from_script: Gold is about 30% below its record, but not in a day: a crowd bought the top, a bad-news day broke the mood, then rates and a strong dollar leaked it out; history says fast falls and long waits both happen; nobody knows what is next.
words_per_s_note: 1,481 words is about 9.9 min at 2.5 w/s with no gaps; 9.1 min at 2.7 w/s. With stamps, on-screen beats and pauses it will run about 10.3-10.8 min: trim 60-90 words to keep it at 9-10.

gap_to_gate.problem: S3/S4 piece four: the skip beat is placed right, but l051's 'Wait. One bar is worth 1.5 million' is a loose fact, then the seesaw arrives with no link. Also 'Wait.' repeats l003.
gap_to_gate.fix: l051 (Karto): "Hold on. One standard gold bar is worth about one and a half million dollars, and it pays you nothing, ever. Piece seven shows how small all the gold in the world really is." l049 (Karto): "Watch the seesaw. When rates rise, holding that bar costs you the interest you gave up. The seesaw tips, and money slides off the gold end."

gap_to_gate.problem: S7/claims: 'nobody lost thirty percent in one day' is absolute; 'Everyone else' sold overstates what the evidence says.
gap_to_gate.fix: l001: "But gold did not fall thirty percent in one day." l005: "Many others. In one January day gold fell almost a tenth of its price. And at the Dubai Gold Souk, sellers lined up in queues. Seven pieces. You will see every one."

gap_to_gate.problem: Ending S8/S10 and piece-7 drag: 'Nobody knows/agrees' three times; l093 promises Skip's question, then the card interrupts for five lines; l093 reuses the 'Small answer' tag a third time.
gap_to_gate.fix: l088: "The bull: James Stanley expects a short-term move back above four thousand." (drop 'Nobody agrees') l090 keep. l093: "Central banks still buy, and forecasts disagree. Skip has the big question, after the score card." l098: "And I will not tell you what to do with gold."

gap_to_gate.problem: S7/S10: five of seven pieces still end on a 'But why/who/has...?' question teaser; l096 (17 words) and l023 (20 words) are too long to say aloud; script runs 60-90 words over for 9-10 min.
gap_to_gate.fix: Turn l056 into a Skip line: SKIP: "So who gets hurt when it tips?" and make l069 a statement: "Three kinds of people feel it. History is next." Split l096: "Gold is about thirty percent below its record. Not in a day. Central banks, as a group, kept buying. Some analysts say a crowd bought near the top, then rates and the dollar changed the mood." Cut l014 to "Everybody: people hiding from a nervous world, and bets on lower rates and a weaker dollar." Cut the 'guess in a nice suit' half of l084.
